_editing: The campaign photo gallery. Drop final photos into /public/images and point `src` at them (e.g. "/images/town-hall-01.jpg"), then write a real `caption` and `alt`. Slots with an empty `src` render a neutral, obviously-empty placeholder tile — deliberately not a stock photo, so nothing can be mistaken for a real campaign photograph. Add or remove items freely; the grid reflows and the category filter builds itself from the `category` values used.
